description: Check Datadog keys. With api_key, app_key and optional site (us1, us3, us5, eu1, ap1, ap2, uk1, us1_fed, us2_fed; default us1): ask Datadog whether it accepts them, saving nothing. With key_id: check a key pair saved in Settings, Integrations again and record the answer. Returns whether the pair is valid, whether each key was accepted (the application key reads null when Datadog could not check it) and the site. Needs a Last Price credential with the integrations:write scope, and Datadog offered to the workspace (404 otherwise; list_integrations says). Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

api_key.description: A Datadog API key to check without saving.

app_key.description: A Datadog application key to check without saving.

key_id.description: A saved key pair to check again. Give this or api_key and app_key.

site.description: The Datadog site of the keys. Default us1.

name: test_datadog_keys
